hero_subhead: Tired of overgrown borders and patchy lawns? G17 transforms Sutton Coldfield gardens with reliable, hands-on maintenance.
services_heading: Complete Garden Maintenance Services in Sutton Coldfield
services_subhead: From weekly lawn care to seasonal deep cleans, we keep your garden thriving year-round.

services.title: Weekly & Fortnightly Lawn Care
services.desc: Regular grass cutting, edge trimming, and seasonal feeding to keep your lawn healthy and neat. We adjust our schedule to the season and your garden's needs.

services.title: Hedge & Shrub Trimming
services.desc: Expert pruning and shaping of hedges, shrubs, and climbers. We keep boundaries tidy and encourage healthy growth without damaging established plants.

services.title: Seasonal Garden Clearance
services.desc: Spring and autumn deep cleans remove dead foliage, fallen leaves, and debris. We'll mulch borders and prepare your garden for the months ahead.

services.title: Flower Bed & Border Care
services.desc: Weeding, replanting, and deadheading to keep borders looking vibrant. We'll suggest seasonal varieties that thrive in Sutton Coldfield's soil and climate.

services.title: Garden Tidy-Up & Restoration
services.desc: Transform neglected or overgrown gardens into usable outdoor spaces. We remove excess growth, repair fencing, and restore the structure you've lost.

services.title: Patio & Driveway Cleaning
services.desc: Remove moss, algae, and dirt with pressure washing or soft cleaning. Safe, effective methods that protect your surfaces and improve kerb appeal.

about_pullquote: I got into gardening because I love seeing a neglected space transform into somewhere families actually want to spend time.
about_para_1: G17 Garden Maintenance was founded on the principle that a well-kept garden should be accessible to everyone — not just those with time or expertise. Over 12 years, we've worked on hundreds of gardens across Sutton Coldfield and Birmingham, from small urban backyards to larger country properties. We understand the West Midlands climate and soil, and we're not afraid of hard graft.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we treat every garden with the same care, turn up on time, and explain what we're doing — not just present you with a bill. We're equipped to handle everything from routine maintenance to complete overgrowth clearance, and we're always happy to recommend the best approach for your space and budget.
reviews_heading: What Sutton Coldfield Homeowners Say About G17

reviews.text: Been using G17 for nearly three years now. The lads show up when they say they will, the garden always looks immaculate, and they're happy to chat through seasonal changes. Fair prices too. Really can't fault them.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Our back garden was completely overgrown — hadn't been touched for two years. I was worried it would take weeks to sort, but G17 cleared the lot in a morning. Professional, tidy, and they even offered advice on what plants to keep. Brilliant work.
reviews.author: Christine M.

reviews.text: Called them for a quick quote and ended up with a proper conversation about what the garden needed. No pushy sales, just honest advice. They've been maintaining it monthly since and it's the best it's looked. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Richard S.
